outbound_communications_sent_at_required.name: outbound_communications_sent_at_required
outbound_communications_sent_at_required.value: "outbound_communications"."status" not in ('sent', 'delivered') or "outbound_communications"."sent_at" is not null

proposals_contact_consistent.name: proposals_contact_consistent
proposals_contact_consistent.value: ("proposals"."submission_mode" = 'anonymous' and "proposals"."contact_email" is null) or ("proposals"."submission_mode" = 'contact' and "proposals"."contact_email" is not null and length(trim("proposals"."contact_email")) > 0)

recipients_contact_required.name: recipients_contact_required
recipients_contact_required.value: "recipients"."email" is not null or "recipients"."pec" is not null

reports_public_status_requires_approval.name: reports_public_status_requires_approval
reports_public_status_requires_approval.value:
("reports"."moderation_status" = 'approved' and "reports"."public_status" is not null)
        or ("reports"."moderation_status" <> 'approved' and "reports"."public_status" is null)

reports_public_status_requires_published.name: reports_public_status_requires_published_at
reports_public_status_requires_published.value: "reports"."public_status" is null or "reports"."published_at" is not null

reports_communicated_or_resolved_require.name: reports_communicated_or_resolved_requires_communicated_at
reports_communicated_or_resolved_require.value: "reports"."public_status" not in ('communicated', 'resolved') or "reports"."communicated_at" is not null

reports_resolved_requires_resolved_at.name: reports_resolved_requires_resolved_at
reports_resolved_requires_resolved_at.value: "reports"."public_status" is distinct from 'resolved' or "reports"."resolved_at" is not null
